CASTING CALL, paid, non-union. Toronto / GTA.

We're a small Canadian home wellness brand shooting a short commercial with a Toronto crew on Aug 29-30 (backup Sept 5-6). Interiors, no travel.

Looking for:

- Mother, 65-75. Speaks to camera, teleprompter provided. One day.

- Daughter, 45-55. Speaks to camera. Two half days.

- Friend, 60-75. No lines. Part day.

We're casting the mother and daughter as a pair. If you know someone who could pass as your mom or your daughter, apply together.

To apply, email ask@silvie.com with your role in the subject line:

- two recent photos, one headshot, one full length

- a 60-second phone video, natural, reading the line on the poster

- your rate, your city, and which weekend you can do

Everyone who sends a tape gets a reply.

🎄✨ MAGIC ELF ROLES @ LaplandUK | MANCHESTER & ASCOT ✨🎄
📍 Locations: Ascot & Manchester

💷 Pay: £13.75 per hour + 12.07% holiday pay

🔞 Age: 18+

✨ HELP BRING CHRISTMAS TO LIFE THIS WINTER! ✨

LaplandUK is now casting Magic Elves to join our magical festive experience at both our Ascot and Manchester sites.

🎅 Featured in its own Channel 4 documentary and showcased on The Apprentice, LaplandUK is recognised as one of the UK’s leading immersive festive experiences.

🧝‍♀️ WHAT DOES A MAGIC ELF DO?

This is a highly interactive role where you’ll help create unforgettable Christmas memories for families. You’ll:

🎄 Escort families through the experience

🎅 Guide guests to Father Christmas’ woodland cabin

📸 Take photographs during their visit

✨ Help make sure every guest has a truly magical experience

🤝 Work in pairs throughout an 8-hour shift

🎭 Combine performance with operational responsibilities

No previous acting experience is required! We’re looking for people with warmth, energy and a genuine passion for creating magical experiences for children and their families. ❤️

🎁 WHAT’S INCLUDED?

✅ Paid 9-week seasonal contract (October–December)

✅ Paid training

🚐 Free shuttle service from Macclesfield Station (Manchester site)

🚗 Free on-site parking

🍽️ Free hot meal on every shift

👗 Professional costume & wardrobe provided

📌 PLEASE NOTE:

• No visible neck or lower arm tattoos due to costume requirements

• Applicants must be available for at least 3 shifts per week

🎟️ NOW BOOKING AUDITIONS!

📩 To apply or find out more, email resourcing@lapland.group with your CV or any questions.

🔗 APPLY HERE:

https://laplanduk.fillout.com/recruitment2026

🎄 Know someone who would make a fantastic Magic Elf? Tag them below or share this post! 🧝✨

🎅✨ WE’RE HIRING – FATHER CHRISTMAS | LAPLANDUK 2026 ✨🎅
📍 Ascot, Berkshire & Macclesfield, Cheshire
💷 £20.50 per hour + £50 working day subsidy + 12.07% holiday pay

🎄 BRING THE MAGIC OF CHRISTMAS TO LIFE! 🎄

This Christmas, we’re looking for exceptional performers to step into one of the world’s most iconic roles — Father Christmas — at LaplandUK.

✨ Each year, more than 180,000 guests visit LaplandUK, one of the UK’s most celebrated immersive theatrical experiences.

With breathtaking sets, captivating storytelling and world-class production, every visit is designed to create memories that last a lifetime. ❤️

🎅 AS FATHER CHRISTMAS, YOU’LL:

✨ Deliver heartfelt, immersive performances
❤️ Create unforgettable interactions with every family
🎭 Confidently improvise while staying true to the LaplandUK story
🧝 Work alongside our talented Elf cast to create a seamless guest experience
🎄 Help make Christmas truly magical for thousands of families

💰 MOST PERFORMERS EARN BETWEEN £5,000 AND £10,000 OVER THE SEASON.

We’re looking for performers with warmth, presence and a genuine ability to connect with children and families.

If you have a warm, kind presence and would love the opportunity to play Father Christmas at one of the UK’s most magical Christmas experiences, we’d love to hear from you. 🎅✨

📝 HOW TO APPLY

Complete our short Google Form using the link below.

Once you’ve submitted your details, our Recruitment Team will review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

🔗 APPLY HERE:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVhuxlIfQqIE_UAKZDaXmp5BufJ3P-UU5jZKwqERX7JwRLHw/viewform

🎄 Please share this post with anyone you think would be perfect for this unique opportunity.

✨ Could you be our Father Christmas? 🎅

✨ CASTING CALL – MPP CHARACTER ENTERTAINMENT ✨
💙 MALE CHARACTER ENTERTAINERS WANTED! 💙

MPP Character Entertainment is seeking high energy male performers to join our team and bring a range of exciting character roles to life!

We’re looking for performers who can step into larger than life characters inspired by some of the most loved family, adventure, superhero, western, festive and fantasy characters bringing their own personality, energy and creativity to every performance.

🎭 ABOUT THE ROLE

We are casting male performers to portray a variety of vibrant character entertainers, combining:

• High-energy performance

• Character acting & improvisation

• Engaging interactions with children and families

• Confidence performing in costume and staying in character

• Creating memorable experiences at parties and events

🌟 CHARACTER STYLES MAY INCLUDE:

🎅 Festive & Christmas characters

🚀 Space & adventure heroes

🦸 Superhero-inspired characters

🤠 Classic cowboy characters

🏴‍☠️ Swashbuckling pirate characters

❄️ Magical winter & ice-inspired characters

💪 PERFORMER REQUIREMENTS

• Male performers aged 18+

• Experience in entertainment, theatre or character work preferred, but NOT required

• Outgoing, energetic and confident

• Great with children and families

• Reliable and professional

• Based in or able to travel to Manchester / North West

• Availability for weekend bookings

• Driving Licence and Car essential

💰 WHAT WE OFFER

• Paid performance opportunities

• Flexible, freelance work

• A supportive and creative team environment

• A variety of exciting character roles

• Parties, events and immersive experiences

• The opportunity to build your experience as a professional character entertainer

📸 HOW TO APPLY

If you’re confident, energetic and love entertaining, we’d love to hear from you!

Please send your CV and headshot/image to:

📧 manager@mppcharacterentertainment.com

****All travel and medical expenses are covered by the production. ***

****Dr. Pimple Popper is just one of many doctors that can treat these conditions.***

**URGENT LOS ANGELES CASTING — BLACK BOY, AGES 10–14**

Hey everyone, my name is Dayna Iniguez and I’m helping with casting for an independent short film, directed by Los Angeles filmmaker Reginald “Reggie” Hughes. We shoot **this Sunday, August 23**, so this is an **urgent casting search** trying to fill one remaining youth role. We are looking for a **Black boy around 10–14 years old **to play MAN-MAN, a small but pivotal supporting role.

**What we’re looking for:**
• Comfortable taking direction
• Acting experience is **not required**
• Parent/guardian involvement is required

**Compensation:** Unpaid
**Provided:** Meals, screen credit, and footage

This is a small independent narrative production with a professional crew, open to first-time performers. If you have a son, nephew, younger brother, cousin, student, athlete, or know **any Black boy ages 10–15 who may be interested**, please **tag/share this with their parent or guardian**.

Interested parents/guardians can **message me directly**, and I can connect you with Reggie and send over the script, character information, schedule, and full production details.

**Director:** Reginald “Reggie” Hughes
**Director's Portfolio:** [[https://www.reggiehughesportfolio.org/](https://www.reggiehughesportfolio.org/)](https://www.reggiehughesportfolio.org/)
**Director's Linkedin: **[https://www.linkedin.com/in/reggie-hughes-38131a263/](https://www.linkedin.com/in/reggie-hughes-38131a263/)

**Casting form:** [[https://tally.so/r/PdNzB5](https://tally.so/r/PdNzB5)](https://tally.so/r/PdNzB5)

**Please share — we only need one kid who fits.**

Hi everyone, I’m Luke, 20, screen actor based in Lancashire. Sharing my showreel as I’m actively looking for TV/film work and building toward representation.

Credits include the lead role in short film “Deadly Intentions” and a role in “The Interview.” Currently rehearsing “Things We Said Today” (Pocket Money Collective), playing Neil Aspinall.

Also recently had the chance to get feedback on my work from Phillip Barantini as part of an acting class — video attached below.

Open to roles, always keen to connect with fellow actors, filmmakers and casting folks in the North West. Feel free to message or share if you know of anything going!

items.summary:
Hi everyone, I’m Luke, 20, screen actor based in Lancashire. Sharing my showreel as I’m actively looking for TV/film work and building toward representation.

Credits include the lead role in short film “Deadly Intentions” and a role in “The Interview.” Currently rehearsing “Things We Said Today” (Pocket Money Collective), playing Neil Aspinall.

Also recently had the chance to get feedback on my work from Phillip Barantini as part of an acting class — video attached below.

Open to roles, always keen to connect with fellow actors, filmmakers and casting folks in the North West. Feel free to message or share if you know of anything going!

🔥🔥  🎬
Fam I’m currently working as a Story Researcher for 3 major TV reality shows and I’m looking for *REAL PEOPLE WITH REAL STORIES.*

1. MY BODY MY STORY (TV SHOW)🎬🎥
_________________________
We’re looking for people living with life-changing physical conditions, visible or invisible disabilities, rare conditions, body-related challenges, or experiences that have deeply affected their confidence, relationships, family or everyday life. We want powerful stories of struggle, resilience and transformation.

2. KONAKELE KITHI 🎬🎥
————————————————
We’re looking for families who are in desperate need of help. Whatever the issue may be, we want to hear your story. Selected families will be given an opportunity to work through their challenges with a professional psychologist through therapy and support.

3. I’M WITH YOUR EX 🎥🎬
—————————————————-
We’re looking for couples who are currently dating but need to confess to their ex that they are now together. If your relationship has a complicated past and you’re ready to tell your ex the truth, we want to hear your story.

🚨 IMPORTANT:
We are looking for REAL STORIES ONLY.
❌ No actors
❌ No social media influencers
❌ No fake or scripted stories

📩 DM your story to my inbox (China Connector Mokgalaboke) or WhatsApp 065 898 2744 – Devine Fame Talents Agency.

💯 You DO NOT PAY ANY MONEY to be considered or participate in the show.

Your story could help someone else. Tell us your story. 🎥❤️SHARE THIS✅

**🎬 SUPPORTING ARTISTS WANTED, FEATURE FILM, EAST LONDON 🎬**

We’re looking for Supporting Artists to join us for our upcoming independent feature film CAST ME!

CAST ME! is a darkly comic feature following Aanya, a young actor whose pursuit of the role of a lifetime begins to spiral into obsession.

We’re currently looking for people across the following dates:

**THURSDAY 20TH AUGUST**
Nightclub, Party Goers and Entourage
13:30 to 19:00 and/or 2300

**FRIDAY 21ST AUGUST**
Nightclub, Party Goers and Entourage
15:00 to 20:00 and/or 2300

🪩 These are fun, short shooting days creating a lively nightclub scene. If you’re available for both days, you’ll be part of our lead’s Party Entourage!

**TUESDAY 25TH AUGUST**
Acting Workshop
08:00 to 18:00

**WEDNESDAY 26TH AUGUST**
Acting Workshop
08:00 to 18:00

**THURSDAY 27TH AUGUST**
Acting Workshop
08:00 to 19:00

For these three days, we’re looking for actors and performers to portray actors taking part in a professional Acting Workshop. Availability across multiple days is particularly helpful for continuity.

**MONDAY 31ST AUGUST**
Young Performer Workshop
08:00 to 18:00

Looking for young and emerging performers to portray actors attending a workshop.

📍 Playhouse East, 258 Kingsland Road, London E8 4DG

No previous Supporting Artist experience is required. Actors, performers and anyone comfortable being on camera are very welcome.

This is expenses only. Public transport is reimbursed up to £15 per day and food is provided.

Interested? Please message Penny on +44 7498 306830 with a phot and the Date/ dates available! 

Feel free to share with anyone who might be interested! 🎬🪩

Thank you all!

CASTING PAID ROLES FOR SEASON 4 OF OUR ACTING COMPETITION AND THE UPCOMING DARK COMEDY / FANTASY SHORT “PENNY & LANA” — AUSTIN, TX

Please read the full breakdown in the description below before submitting.

——————————————————

Written by Rob Borrego, EP / Creator

Produced & Directed by Sheilava

Logline:

Two middle-aged female fugitives take a mysterious “de-aging pill” in order to escape the law and have one last wild night as young women with a second chance at redemption.

*NOTE: 

This is a non-union, independent production filming in the Greater Austin Area.

ALL TALENT MUST BE BASED IN THE GREATER AUSTIN AREA — this is an Austin-based acting competition and production.  No lodging, transportation, or travel compensation will be provided.

Select Talent will appear in our dark comedy/fantasy short, as well as 1-5 episodes of Season 4 of our YouTube acting competition consisting of four rounds of a recorded callback audition process (see link for a peek at our show: 

https://l.instagram.com/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutu.be%2Fnm2h-dfjwK8%3Fis%3DpIcLl7mOg7UxZ4QK&e=AUB9XmbuRTVX_5zBQU_A5GbpGa4zlMuWDFc7VhuH_BCoq_9-14dRnr0w65ngNGBuMFxUCbpxb1yuL4Hx6u513SqlBY20x1n0VUxmxaiLM4HE_0EgTQANSuU2iQgY

To be considered, all talent must be fully available for our in-person pre-screening Callback round on Friday, August 28 (time slots are scheduled between 10:30 AM - 4:00 PM.

Please do not submit if you cannot be available on this date!

——————————————————

YOUNG PENNY - LEAD, EARLY 20s

FEMALE, BLONDE, CAUCASIAN

The planner, the strategist, and the sharper, drier half of “The Bling Queens.”  She produces the de-aging pills and quietly carries the guilt.

$250/day, meals, IMDb credit

Selected Talent must be fully available during the following production dates:  

September 4, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22.  

*Note: we are scheduled to film late evening scenes on 9/18-9/19 and overnights for exterior nighttime scenes on 9/20-9/22.  

Please do not submit if you cannot be fully available for these dates/times!

——————————————————

YOUNG LANA - LEAD, EARLY 20s

FEMALE, BROWN EYES, DARK HAIR, 
MIXED-RACE / CAUCASIAN PRESENTING

Bubbly, impulsive, and fiercely devoted, Lana is the live-it-up counterweight to Penny’s caution. Her lifelong loyalty to Penny is the friendship our story rests on.

$250/day, meals, IMDb credit

Selected Talent must be fully available during the following production dates:  

September 4, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22.  

*Note: we are scheduled to film late evening scenes on 9/18-9/19 and overnights for exterior nighttime scenes on 9/20-9/22.  

Please do not submit if you cannot be fully available for these dates/times!

——————————————————

JAMES — SUPPORTING, EARLY 40s

MALE, BROWN HAIR, BROWN EYES, CAUCASIAN

James is Andrew’s lifelong friend and partner in their yearly ritual of borrowed youth. He is young at heart, lively, impetuous, and incredibly loyal.

$150/day, meal, IMDb credit, needed for 1 day

*Selected Talent will be needed on 9/19 for an overnight exterior shoot starting no earlier than 7pm. 

——————————————————

***SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS***

Send us an email with the subject line: 

YOUR NAME + CHARACTER NAME

Include the following in your email:

- headshots 
- a recent/candid photo (selfies are ok)
- resume, reels, IMDb, and/or links to previous work 

Send to:

callbackscompetition@gmail.com

——————————————————

DEADLINE TO SUBMIT:  
THURSDAY, AUGUST 20th, 12 PM NOON

Øveperiode: 3. september – 27. november 2026 på Frederiksberg.
Spilledatoer/spillested: 28. november – 20. december 2026 i KU•BE på Frederiksberg.

🚔 Polizei-Aufbauworkshop mit Schießtraining 🔫🎬

Du hast bereits unseren DU BIST FILM Basis-Workshop absolviert oder verfügst über Erfahrung bei Polizei, Bundeswehr, Justiz, Sicherheitsdienst oder als Polizei-Komparse? Dann ist dieser exklusive Aufbauworkshop genau das Richtige für dich.

📅 01.11.2026 | Dachau

👮 Authentische Polizeiarbeit vor der Kamera

items.text:
Mira Tzenov: Wie weit geht sie für ihre Schauspielkarriere? Karrideo TV - Dein Karriere Video 

Mira Tzenov will als Schauspielerin vor die Kamera. Im Interview in Köln erzählt sie von spontanen Castings, ihren Wunschrollen und davon, wie weit sie für ihre Schauspielkarriere gehen würde. 
 
Was passiert, wenn aus dem Traum von der großen Leinwand plötzlich eine echte Chance wird? 
 
Karrideo - Dein Karrierevideo trifft Schauspiel-Newcomerin Mira Tzenov im Rheinauhafen Köln. Direkt am Sommerkino sprechen wir darüber, wie es sich für sie anfühlen würde, eines Tages den eigenen Namen im Vor- oder Abspann eines Kinofilms zu entdecken. 
 
Dabei zeigt Mira Tzenov, wie viel Spontaneität eine Schauspielkarriere verlangen kann. Sonntagabend gegen 21 Uhr kam die Nachricht, dass sie eine weitere Casting-Runde erreicht hatte. Die Frage: Kann sie am nächsten Morgen um 10 Uhr in München sein? Ihre Antwort war klar. Um 4 Uhr morgens ging es von Köln Richtung München. 
 
Im Interview verrät Mira außerdem, welche Rollen sie besonders reizen. Gerade Figuren, die einen starken Kontrast zu ihrer eigenen Persönlichkeit bilden, findet sie spannend. Eine fiese Freundin, eine Diva oder eine Rolle in einer Komödie kann sie sich gut vorstellen. 

Christian Weiße begleitet das Interview als Interviewer, Moderator und Produzent für Karrideo - Dein Karrierevideo. 

Welche Filmrolle würdest Du Mira Tzenov sofort zutrauen? Schreib Deine Idee in die Kommentare. 

#MiraTzenov #Schauspielerin #Casting #Schauspiel #Karrideo

UNPAID COLLABORATION] Auteure Films Seeking Creative Editor for Indie Short Horror this week, August 20-23.
Logline:
When a 25-year-old woman is diagnosed with a rare geriatric illness, her search for comfort in a medical support group uncovers a terrifying connection between her symptoms and a sinister entity from her childhood.
About the Project:
Genre: Horror / Psychological Thriller
Length: 5–10 minutes (Festival/Competition Requirement)
Status: Shot and wrapped. Footage is organized and ready for assembly.
Tone/Style: Inspired by Coralie Fargeat’s provocative, jarring, and visceral style. We want to challenge the audience and force them to question reality and the plague of loneliness and invisibility. 
What We Offer:
IMDb credit.
High-quality footage for your portfolio/reel.
Industry education and networking through a structured short horror competition.
How to Apply:
Please send a link of your reel or portfolio and a brief note about why this concept excites you to auteure.casting@gmail.com

*POSZUKUJĘ LUDZI DO PROJEKTU LICENCJACKIEGO!*
*Stwórzmy razem eksperymentalny spektakl!*

Hej, studiuję Intermedia na ASP w Gdańsku i w najbliższym roku akademickim będę pracować nad moim projektem licencjackim. 

**Trochę o mnie : **
Jestem artystką, która eksperymentuje przede wszystkim z fotografią tradycyjną. W swojej pracy opieram się na łączeniu i eksplorowaniu form ekspresji. Mam ogromną miłość i potrzebę sztuki na żywo, teatru, tańca i ruchu ciała.

Ukończyłam Sopocką Szkołę Fotografii WFH w 2025 roku, broniąc dyplomu z fotografii, projektem „Wyzwolenie Orgazmu”.

Ukończyłam wymianę studencką w semestrze zimowym 2025/26 w HfK Bremen w Niemczech.

Jestem weganką, tworzę z myślą o upcyklingu i zero waste, interesuję się wpływem człowieka na rzeczywistość, postawami społecznymi, tabu związanymi z seksem, orgazmem i ciałem.

**Trochę o projekcie licencjackim : **
Chciałabym, żebyśmy razem stworzyli/ły eksperymentalny spektakl z elementami ruchowymi na temat aktualnych nastrojów społecznych w Polsce. Głównymi obszarami badań i inspiracjii jest komunikacja miejska.

**Wymagania : **
- Otwartość na rozmowy w grupie,
- Dyspozycyjność na spotkania ok. 2h raz na dwa tygodnie w okresie październik 2026 - czerwiec 2027 (będziemy razem dogadywać konkretne daty),
- Nie musisz mieć doświadczenia aktorskiego/artystycznego,
- >18 lat,

**Co możesz zyskać : **
- Udział i wspólne tworzenie projektu licencjackiego na ASP w Gdańsku,
- Możliwość wysyłania naszego projektu na festiwale, 
- Doświadczenie pracy w grupie i wyjątkowy projekt artystyczny do portfolio,
- Nowych znajomych do głębokich i nie głębokich rozmów,

Spotkajmy się, pogadajmy!
Napisz do mnie wiadomość.

Wrzucam moje prace :

🎬 FILM CREW WANTED – ITALIAN-AMERICAN MAFIA SHORT FILM
We’re looking for volunteer film crew to join an independent Italian-American Mafia short film currently being developed and filmed in Sydney, NSW.

This is a no-budget passion project being created to build a professional-quality short film/showreel. We’re looking for people who are passionate about filmmaking and want hands-on experience working on a narrative production.

🎥 CREW ROLES WANTED:
• 🎬 Cinematographer / Director of Photography (DoP)
• 📷 Camera Operator
• 🎙️ Sound Recordist / Boom Operator
• 💡 Gaffer / Lighting Technician
• 🎞️ 1st Assistant Camera (1st AC)
• 🎞️ 2nd Assistant Camera (2nd AC)
• 🎬 Grip
• 🎨 Production Designer / Art Department
• 👔 Costume / Wardrobe
• 💄 Hair & Makeup
• 📋 Script Supervisor
• 🎬 Assistant Director (AD)
• 📦 Production Assistants / General Crew
• ✂️ Editor / Post-Production
• 🎨 Colourist
• 🎵 Sound Design / Music

📍 Location: Sydney, NSW
📅 Filming dates: TBA
💰 UNPAID / VOLUNTEER: This is a no-budget production, so unfortunately crew positions are unpaid. Meals/refreshments will be provided where possible, and everyone involved will receive screen credit.

You do not need professional industry experience to get involved. Film students, emerging filmmakers, hobbyists and experienced crew are all welcome.

If you’re interested, DM me with your role/experience, any equipment you have access to, and your general availability.

Let’s make something great together. 🎬

**CASTING: Kampania dla szwedzkiej marki karmy dla zwierząt**

Poszukujemy bohaterki wraz z pupilami do nagrania materiału wideo (Instagram Reel) dla szwedzkiego producenta karmy. Opcjonalnie poszukujemy włącznie z lokalizacją, urokliwym domem, w którym można zrealizować materiał.

**Kogo szukamy:**
* Kobiety w wieku 35–50 lat.
* Właścicielki **psa i kota (warunek konieczny)**, które żyją w zgodzie i lubią się nawzajem. W nagraniu wystąpią wszyscy.

**Szczegóły współpracy:**
* Lokalizacja: okolice Warszawy.
* Termin nagrań: wstępnie 15–30 września.
* Forma współpracy: umowa zlecenie lub umowa o dzieło (udział płatny).
* Zakres: pełne prawa do wizerunku i emisja w kampanii w mediach społecznościowych.

**Zgłoszenia:** Zgłoszenia prosimy przesyłać na adres: kontakt@menippe.pl lub w prywatnej wiadomości.

W treści maila prosimy zawrzeć:
1. Swoje zdjęcie lub portfolio.
2. Zdjęcia zwierząt.
3. Krótki opis (skąd jesteś, informacje o sobie i zwierzakach oraz szczegóły dotyczące ich relacji).
4. Wszelkie dodatkowe informacje, które mogą być istotne.
5. Numer telefonu do kontaktu.
6. Opcjonalnie: zdjęcia nieruchomości, przybliżona lokalizacja, opis.

items.text:
🎙️ **Deutscher männlicher Sprecher / Creator für regelmäßigen YouTube-Kanal gesucht**

Ich suche einen **muttersprachlichen deutschen Sprecher** für einen neuen YouTube-Kanal über **Finanzbetrug, Wirtschaftsskandale, Ponzi-Systeme und außergewöhnliche Kriminalfälle**.

Die Videos werden meist ca. **25–40 Minuten** lang sein. Das fertige deutsche Skript wird von mir geliefert.

Gesucht wird:
* männliche deutsche Stimme
* natürliche, ruhige und spannende Erzählweise
* saubere Audioaufnahme
* zusätzlich eine einfache Videoaufnahme während des Sprechens

Das Video kann ganz unkompliziert mit dem **Smartphone** aufgenommen werden. Idealerweise seitlich bzw. im 3/4-Winkel, sodass Gesicht und Mund sichtbar sind. Professionelle Kamera oder aufwendige Videoproduktion sind nicht nötig.

Es geht um eine **regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit**.

💶 Budget für die ersten Folgen: ca. **30–50 € pro Episode**.
Auch Anfänger, Schauspieler, UGC-Creator oder angehende Sprecher sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Bei Interesse bitte gerne eine kurze Sprachprobe oder einen Link zu bisherigen Arbeiten per PN schicken.

Beispiel für den gewünschten Stil / die Einbindung des Sprechers:
[https://youtu.be/R64LEScn3-Q?is=NozwUDMY1udxFFQZ](https://youtu.be/R64LEScn3-Q?is=NozwUDMY1udxFFQZ)

Für einen Trailer im Stil von Quentin Tarantino suchen wir eine junge Schauspielerin im Spielalter von ca. 20 bis 29 Jahren.

Rollenprofil:
Du spielst eine Kassiererin, die zunächst unscheinbar und unschuldig wirkt. Gesucht wird ein zierlicher, sehr natürlicher Typ, gerne mit dem Look eines sympathischen „Mädchens vom Land“. Kein auffälliges Make up, keine glamouröse Erscheinung. Natürlichkeit ist uns wichtig.

Die Rolle beinhaltet Dialog und endet in einer inszenierten Erschießungsszene. Die entsprechenden Effekte werden selbstverständlich filmisch umgesetzt.

Drehort: Nordhorn
Drehzeitraum: voraussichtlich Ende August 2026
Drehumfang: 2 Drehtage
Gage: No Budget, keine Gage
Fahrt und Übernachtungskosten: können leider nicht übernommen werden
Verpflegung: Für Verpflegung am Set wird selbstverständlich gesorgt.

Daher suchen wir bevorzugt Schauspielerinnen aus Nordhorn und Umgebung.

Der Trailer ist Teil eines eigenständigen Filmprojekts und soll einen markanten, schwarzhumorigen Action und Crime Stil bekommen.

Bei Interesse schick uns bitte eine kurze Vorstellung sowie aktuelle Fotos und, falls vorhanden, einen Link zu deinem Showreel oder Schauspielprofil an:

📧 a.artur@gmx.net

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen! 🎬

items.text:
# **BLIV EN DEL AF ONDT**

 

Til efteråret præsenterer **Teltet på Bakken** og **Dystopia Entertainment** horrorforestillingen **ONDT** – en ny, intens og anderledes teateroplevelse, hvor publikum træder direkte ind i fortællingen.

 

Vi søger nu frivillige medvirkende, der har lyst til at blive en del af et ambitiøst, professionelt  og kreativt fællesskab. Rollerne er ulønnede, men til gengæld bliver du en vigtig del af en professionel teaterproduktion og er med til at skabe noget, ingen har oplevet før.

 

Som medvirkende bliver du en del af et unikt kunstnerisk fællesskab, hvor frivillige medvirkende, professionelle skuespillere og instruktørerne **Henrik Grimbäck** og **Christina Neumann Jensen** sammen skaber ONDT – fra de første prøver til den sidste forestilling.

I **ONDT** er publikum ikke blot tilskuere – de befinder sig midt i forestillingen. Du bliver en del af det univers, der omgiver dem, og er med til at skabe de øjeblikke, de husker længe efter, de har forladt teltet.

 

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med teater. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde fysisk, være tæt på publikum og indgå i et stærkt ensemble, hvor alle bidrager til den samlede oplevelse.

 

**HVILKEN ROLLE PASSER TIL DIG?**

 

**WILDCARDET**

Kan du lidt af det hele? Du har god energi, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at være en del af et stærkt fællesskab. Vi leder efter mennesker med nysgerrighed, engagement og lyst til at kaste sig ud i noget nyt.

 

**SNIGERNE**

Er du gymnast, parkourudøver, danser eller har du exceptionel kropskontrol? Du kravler, sniger dig og bevæger dig lydløst gennem mørket. Du er der, hvor publikum mindst forventer det.

 

**MONSTRENE**

Du har en stærk fysisk udstråling og tør bruge hele kroppen til at skabe frygt. Store bevægelser, intensitet og nærvær er vigtigere end replikker.

 

**LOKKEDUERNE**

Du ligner en helt almindelig gæst. Du griner, hygger dig og falder naturligt ind blandt publikum – indtil stemningen pludselig ændrer sig. Rollen kræver nærvær og troværdighed.

 

**OFRET**

Det hele begynder med dig. Du kan skabe ægte frygt og få publikum til at holde vejret. Rollen kræver nærvær, mod og evnen til at give sig fuldt ud.

Vi ønsker et mangfoldigt ensemble og opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge. Har du et særligt talent, en usædvanlig fysik eller en færdighed, som kunne passe ind i ONDTs univers, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

**INTERESSERET?**

Skriv til **[ondt@dystopia.dk](mailto:ondt@dystopia.dk)**

Fortæl lidt om dig selv, vedhæft gerne et billede, og skriv, hvorfor du har lyst til at blive en del af ONDT. Har du særlige færdigheder eller erfaring med bevægelse, dans, gymnastik, parkour, performance eller lignende, må du meget gerne fortælle om det.

 

**Senest d.14/8**

 

**FORLØBIG PRØVEPERIODE**

 

**August**
* 17., 20. og 27. august (eftermiddag/aften)

 

**September**

 
* 2., 9., 11., 15. og 16. september (eftermiddag/aften)
   1. september kl. 10.00–14.00
* Daglige prøver fra 20. september frem til premieren den 25. september.

 

**SPILLEPERIODE**

 

**25. september – 1. november 2026**

 

Se spilledage på:
**billet.cirkusrevyen.dk**

**Vi søger ikke bare medvirkende. Vi søger mennesker, der har lyst til at skabe noget helt særligt sammen med os.**

 

[[https://dystopia.dk/](https://dystopia.dk/)](https://dystopia.dk/)

CASTING CALL — Hope Among The Cosmos | Student Short Film | Rockford, IL Area | 

This particular role is only needed for September 20th and a possible pickup day on October 4th. 

Hope Among The Cosmos is a post-apocalyptic sci-fi story about a father and daughter on a routine trading run that goes very wrong. It's got action, heart, and some genuinely dark moments. 

Think practical effects, real locations, and a story worth telling.

Searching for the following role:

YOUNG XANDER, Male, 8-11: A flashback version of Xander (the lead character). Preferred: African-American, mixed race, or biracial; open to all.

This is a student/indie production, unpaid, but you'll get credit, meals on shoot days, and footage of your work when it's ready.
We need to recast due to scheduling conflict.

Heads up: This film has staged violence, fake blood, and some genuinely dark dramatic moments. Nothing unsafe happens on set, ever, but you should know what you're signing up for. For anyone under 18, a parent or guardian must be on set for the entire time; there are no exceptions.

Email [jordanm.hannah89@gmail.com](mailto:jordanm.hannah89@gmail.com). Subject: Hope Among the Cosmos Casting, [Your Name]. Send a photo, the role you're going for, your September availability, and a little about yourself. 
Experience helps, but it's not what I'm looking for first. A reel is welcome if you have one.

☎️  AUDITION CALL! 

🌻 CALENDAR GIRLS By Tim Firth 🌻

✨ Producer Mike Jewison
✨ Director Dinah Watts
✨ Co-Director Cassandra Allen

📚 ABOUT THE PLAY: 
Calendar Girls is a critically acclaimed, heartwarming comedy-drama based on a true story. It features a group of middle-aged women who pose tastefully nude for a charity calendar to honor a lost loved one. A perfect balance of hilarity, poignant grief, and body positivity. (There are also parts for men and young women.) (This will be fun!!!!)
Full length play in two acts.

📆 AUDITION DATES:
Saturday, October 3 - 1:30 to 4:30 pm
Wednesday, October 7 - 6:30 to 9:30 pm
Friday, October 9 - 6:30 to 9:30 pm
CALL BACKS: Saturday October 17 - 2:00 to 4:00 pm

PERFORMANCE DATES: April 29 to May 9, 2027

REHEARSALS: To start Mid-January, 2027

✅ AUDITION REQUIREMENTS:
Please prepare a 1-2 minute monologue. Keep it short and sassy – and we may ask you to read from the script. NO ACCENTS REQUIRED. If invited to callbacks, you will be asked to read/enact selected sides from the play alongside fellow auditioners.

📩 HOW TO SUBMIT: 
Please visit our Audition page on our website (🔗 in comments) for the full character breakdown, and send your audition request to Dinah at: calendargirlsauditions [at] gmail [dot] com

Greetings! My name is Paul Head, and I’m a Los Angeles-based non-scripted Casting Director. You can view my credits and credentials at www.pauldhead.com. I’m currently casting a premium documentary series for a major cable network exploring an often-unspoken experience.

We’re looking nationwide for people whose spouse or long-term life partner suddenly and unexpectedly left, vanished, or ghosted them without explanation—including people who are still legally married but don’t know where their husband or wife is. 

We’re specifically seeking people who are not currently in communication with their partner, don’t know where they are, don’t understand why they left, and have been unable to find them on their own.

The series offers expert help in finding answers, gaining clarity, and hopefully getting the closure you’ve been looking for.

This is a paid documentary series featuring real people and real, ongoing situations.

items.text:
Nice to meet you all!

I’m an experienced Liverpudlian/Merseyside based actor, voice actor and writer with an absolute love for comedy as well as over the top, passionate characters especially in the theatre (which is probably one of my weak spots, as I haven’t done many subtle roles). But the one thing I love most about acting is that I feel as if I’ve stepped into my own shoes even though I’ve become someone else entirely, almost therapeutic. Recently turning 24 has definitely helped me realise how much I’d love to make this a full time job too.

My dream role would definitely be Wally West (The Flash), but a more realistic one would be a lawyer or a chef. Maybe I’ll be working with one of you guys one day!

items.summary:
Nice to meet you all!

I’m an experienced Liverpudlian/Merseyside based actor, voice actor and writer with an absolute love for comedy as well as over the top, passionate characters especially in the theatre (which is probably one of my weak spots, as I haven’t done many subtle roles). But the one thing I love most about acting is that I feel as if I’ve stepped into my own shoes even though I’ve become someone else entirely, almost therapeutic. Recently turning 24 has definitely helped me realise how much I’d love to make this a full time job too.

My dream role would definitely be Wally West (The Flash), but a more realistic one would be a lawyer or a chef. Maybe I’ll be working with one of you guys one day!

items.text:
🎬 CASTING – FILM KRÓTKOMETRAŻOWY (ok. 20 minut)

Cześć!

Poszukuję aktora do roli głównej do mojego pierwszego większego filmu krótkometrażowego. To dramat wojenny osadzony w realiach II wojny światowej, opowiadający historię spotkania dwóch niemieckich oficerów, które prowadzi do odkrycia bolesnej tajemnicy z przeszłości.

Choć jest to mój pierwszy większy autorski projekt, miałem już okazję zdobywać doświadczenie na profesjonalnym planie filmowym jako dyżurny przy dużej produkcji Telewizji Polsat. Teraz chcę wykorzystać to doświadczenie przy realizacji własnego filmu.

🎭 Poszukiwane role:

* Karl Schmidt (30–35 lat) - rozmiar ubrań L, wzrost ok. 185cm, szczupła sylwetka. 43 > rozmiar buta.

📍 Lokalizacja: województwo świętokrzyskie
📅 Termin zdjęć: koniec września 26-29
Wcześniej dyspozycyjność online.
💰 Projekt non profit – udział bez wynagrodzenia. Film realizowany do portfolio oraz na festiwale filmowe.

Szukam osoby zaangażowanej i chętnej do współtworzenia ambitnego projektu. Zapraszam zarówno aktorów z doświadczeniem, jak i osoby, które chcą zdobyć doświadczenie przed kamerą. 

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany(-a), napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej. Podeślij kilka aktualnych zdjęć, swój wiek oraz – jeśli posiadasz – showreel lub krótkie nagranie swojej gry aktorskiej.

Będzie mi bardzo miło, jeśli udostępnisz ten post. Dziękuję i do zobaczenia na planie! 🎬

items.text:
hej szukamy aktorów do Trudnych Spraw!

Przedział czasowy wymienionych postaci: 6 - 10 WRZEŚNIA
dokładniejsze terminy będziemy ustalać na dniach

1. Monika Kaczmarczyk – 45 - 51 lat, 
żona Włodka, konsultantka w salonie meblowym: 12 scen       
Opis postaci: Ładna, kobieta. Ubiera się w sukienki, spódnice.  

2.Zofia Leszczyńska - 26 - 32 lata,
kochanka Włodka i Janusza:   

9 scen

Opis postaci: profesjonalna aktorka, może zmienić wygląd. Piękna. Występuje jako Zofia, Krystyna i Julia. Zawsze wygląda inaczej - zmienia fryzurę i ubrania. 

3. Janusz Nowacki - 47 - 53 lata,
przyjaciel głównego bohatera, barman: 
13 scen
 Opis postaci: duży, silny, brodaty mężczyzna z tatuażami. 

4.Czesław Matysiak - 47 - 53 lata,
 przyjaciel głównego bohatera, kierowca autobusu:  
9 scen

Opis postaci: niski, chudy. 

5. Bartosz Pawlak 24 - 30 lat, 
przyjaciel Dominika, fałszywy wnuk Małgorzaty

13 scen

Wygląd: Wysoki, szczupły, nerwowy. Jasne włosy. Nosi młodzieżowe ubrania – dżinsy, koszulki, czapki z daszkiem.
Cechy: Oszust. Bezwzględny, zazdrosny, okrutny. Podszywa się pod wnuka Małgorzaty.

6. Małgorzata Chmiel 75 - 81lat,
 babcia Dominika, emerytka
13 scen
Wygląd: Miła, dobra staruszka. Lekko pulchna, siwa. Nie maluje się. Ubiera się schludnie, staromodnie. Zawsze starannie uczesana.
Cechy: Wiele zapomina. Roztargniona. Mówi powoli.

Postacie drugoplanowe: 

1. Alicja Nowacka – 45 - 51 lat,
 żona Janusza, przyjaciółka Moniki: 
5 scen

2. Grażyna Marek – 70 - 76 lat,
 teściowa Włodka:
2 sceny

3. Hanna Rogowska – 49 - 55 lat,
 matka Zofii 
2 sceny

4. Anna Sadowska 24 - 30 lat,
 przyjaciółka Ewy, menedżerka w biurze podróży
9 scen
Wygląd: Szczupła, piękna blondynka. Ubiera się jaskrawo, nawet wyzywająco. Nosi rzucające się w oczy dodatki.
Cechy: Emocjonalna, ekspresyjna, zmysłowa. Od razu zakochuje się w Bartoszu, którego uważa za Dominika.

5. Dominik Chmiel 23 - 29 lat,
 prawdziwy wnuk Małgorzaty, informatyk
10 scen
Wygląd: Wysoki, szczupły. Jasne włosy. Podobny typ urody do Bartosza. Miły, czarujący młody mężczyzna. Ubiera się młodzieżowo, stylowo – dokładnie tak samo jak Bartosz.
Cechy: Ufny, dlatego otworzył się przed znajomym Bartoszem. Czuje winę wobec babci.

EPIZODYŚCI:
1. RATOWNIK 1– ratownik medyczny
1 scen

2. RATOWNIK 2 – ratownik medyczny
1 scena

Wygląd: Poważny, zmęczony wygląd.
Cechy: Profesjonalista.

3. LEKARZ 42 - 48 lat,
 kardiolog ze szpitala
1 scena 

Postacie trzecioplanowe:
1. Barbara Matysiak – 46 - 52 lata,
żona Czesława: 
3 sceny 

2. Strażnik:
1 scena

3. Przechodnia atrakcyjna dziewczyna 24 - 30 lat,
1 scena

płatność gotówką od razu po skończeniu planu zdjęciowego

zgłoszenia z wybraną postacią w temacie, aktualnym zdjęciem, wizytówką i numerem telefonu proszę wysyłać na maila: 

patryk.filarowski@polotmedia.pl

lub na priv, choć tam niektóre wiadomości giną:)

do usłyszenia!

items.text:
Cześć. Do krótkometrażowego (ok. 10 min.) dramatu psychologicznego "Blask" kręconego na terenie Krakowa poszukujemy dwójki aktorów:

1. Mama głównego bohatera (ok. 35-45 lat) - przyjemny, ciepły wygląd, stosunkowo szczupła [0 innych wymagań fizycznych]

2. Ojciec głównego bohatera (podobny wiek) - niekrótkie włosy, niezadbany zarost, (który aktor będzie w stanie nieco dogolić na potrzebę jednej ze scen), wzrost ok. 180 cm [0 innych wymagań fizycznych]

Jesteśmy niezależną grupą filmową, tworzącą filmy z zamiłowania do kina. Nie dysponujemy dużym budżetem, ale zależy nam na profesjonalnym podejściu do realizacji i stworzeniu filmu, z którego zarówno my, jak i aktorzy będziemy mogli być dumni. Oferujemy przede wszystkim ciekawą, emocjonalną rolę, możliwość zdobycia materiału do portfolio oraz udział w projekcie, który planujemy zgłaszać na polskie i zagraniczne festiwale filmowe.

Przewidujemy również wynagrodzenie za dzień zdjęciowy, którego wysokość ustalimy indywidualnie.

We are so excited to announce that a brand new year for Ballet Bugs and Caterpillars will be starting this September at Blue Butterfly!

A new term means new music, activities, dancing, friendships and plenty more fun!

Whether your little one is already a mini mover at Blue Butterfly or you've been thinking about joining us for the first time, we would absolutely love to welcome you!

Our new term blocks and taster sessions are now live and available to purchase on our website, please see the links below:

Caterpillars / https://bluebutterflystudios.co.uk/caterpillars

Our taster sessions are the perfect way to come along, meet us, experience a class and see how your little dancer gets along before committing to a full block!

Please spread the word ❤
We would love for you to share our toddler / pre-school classes with your friends, families, neighbours and anybody you think might have a little dancer who would love to join us!

We cannot wait to see all of our little bugs and caterpillars back in the studio this September!

If you have any further questions or queries, please don't hesitate to get in touch!

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 & 𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋

Hello there! I’m beginning pre-production on an independent horror/thriller short film titled Alan Cartyr.

Logline: After being convicted and sent to a psychiatric institution, a mass-murdering serial killer is brought in for another mandated therapy session with his doctor—but this time, something is different.

𝐀𝐁𝐎𝐔𝐓 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐉𝐄𝐂𝐓
Production Type: Independent Short Film
Genre: Horror / Thriller
Runtime: Approximately 10 minutes
Filming Window: October 2026, Dates TBD
Location: Denver–Colorado Springs, CO, Location TBD

This is currently an unpaid independent project, unless funding is secured really. My long-term goal is to build a consistent team of people to work on future projects intended for YouTube, film festivals, and other platforms.

Meals will be provided during filming, and all cast and crew will receive full film credits and IMDb credit.

The production is expected to require 2–3 days of filming, with the majority of scenes taking place indoors. An additional day may be scheduled if needed for pickups or reshoots.

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆

Doctor Alan
Age: Mid-20s–late 30s
Role: Lead

Doctor Alan is a bold and inquisitive man who possesses a strong sense of misplaced bravery but struggles to recognize where the line should be drawn when it comes to anyone other than himself. This role requires a performance that balances curiosity, tension, and fear.

Cartyr’s Father
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Supporting
A supporting role appearing both off-screen and through silhouette work. This role requires strong physical acting and vocal performance, particularly the ability to portray painful anger through body language, posture, and vocal tonality.

Young Cartyr
Age: 8–15
Role: Supporting
A young version of Cartyr who appears on screen in a dedicated scene. The performance should convey something cold, distant, and hollow, with an emphasis on subtle expression and unsettling presence.

Young Woman
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Supporting / Extra 
A heavily on-screen role requiring limited physical movement and a strong ability to communicate a display of her fearful desperation of freedom through facial expressions and body language.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

The Victims
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Number Needed: 3
Role: Background / Supporting
Three performers needed to loom over the scene and, through body language and physical presence, showing that they silently despise what they see in front of them.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

Extras
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Background
Various victims who will appear briefly throughout intense scenes.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖

Director: Evan “Vander” Moreland

Director of Photography (DP): Billy Causey

Producer: A producer is not absolutely required at this stage, but anyone interested in helping with production logistics or potentially assisting with funding is greatly appreciated.

1st AD: I will also be acting in the film, so I would greatly appreciate someone who can help keep production moving. Responsibilities may include keeping us on schedule, handling basic logistics, coordinating the set, and helping track continuity.

Sound Engineer / Boom Operator: Someone with experience recording clean dialogue and working with production sound would be greatly appreciated. Sound will be especially important to this project, as the film relies heavily on atmosphere, eerie sound design, silence, focus, and subtle audio details to build tension.
(A shotgun microphone and/or boom setup would also be extremely helpful.)

Gaffer
I’ve worked on too many films with my man Billy, and we always end up saying, “We really need a gaffer.” 
So… please help the guy and us out if you can! Someone who can help with lighting setups, equipment, lighting, etc.

SFX Makeup Artist: I have a few people in mind for this position, but collaborative efforts are always welcome. This is a very important role for the project, particularly with the practical wounds and effects involved. The position can potentially be shared.

Editor: An editor is not absolutely required at this stage, but if I can find an editor for post-production, it would be greatly appreciated and would help take some pressure off my plate.

CONTACT INFORMATION

If you’re interested in a cast or crew position, or simply want to help with the project in any capacity, feel free to comment, message, or (preferably) email:
morelandcreativearts@gmail.com

For Cast Applicants,
If you’re interested in a casting role, please submit your headshot, reel, and resume if you have them.

Official filming locations and dates will be announced soon. This casting call is currently for pre-production and early recruitment purposes.

Thank you <3

**PAID-Background Talent call for August 22nd**

We are now looking for background extras for the upcoming short film, "Les Immigrants-The Party", shooting August in East Vancouver. *PAID*

**Short-film Logline:** A romantic dramedy exploring modern dating, identity and self-worth, seen from the eyes of an immigrant woman navigating a chaotic night that shifts from illusion to reality.

* Date: Saturday, August 22, 2026
* Location: Studio at 1500 block E Pender St, Vancouver, BC
* Pay: $40/day honorarium
* Call time: afternoon

What is happening/the scene: we are filming in a studio, in and around an underground dance club where patrons are club goers and with a small number wearing BDSM/fetish/kink wear. And everyone will be mixed throughout the club. Most of the background will be wearing "normal" party/clubbing wear and some will be more fetish risqué. If you are open to it, you have a choice of being either. 

We are looking for adults of **ALL-AGE**S and this is your chance to dress as wild as you want!

If you're interested and available, p**lease send an email** to lesimmigrantsparty@gmail.com

And we'll send you a form to fill out for your details.

PS: if you have friends who would like to come, have them email us as well, we'd love to have them.

Da es sich um ein studentisches Projekt handelt, können wir leider keine Gagen zahlen. Alle Produktionskosten sowie Verpflegung werden selbstverständlich übernommen und das Material kann für Showreels oder ähnliches verwendet werden.

Falls du Zeit und Interesse hast, melde dich unter radicalcityfilm@gmail.com - bitte keine PN! :)

Bonjour à toutes et tous,

Nous sommes à la recherche de nos premières SILHOUETTES PARLANTES pour la série de téléfilms belgo-allemande*** EIFELTOD*** !
En 2 x 90 min, nous serons plongés dans deux enquêtes criminelles révélant progressivement des tragédies familiales.

Nous sommes à la recherche de DEUX ENFANTS
(finalement, ce seront les seuls enfants de moins de 15 ans dont nous aurons besoin sur ce projet) :

** FILLES et GARCONS entre 7 et 11 ans**
**PARLANT ALLEMAND** (1-2 répliques : "Süßes, sonst gibt’s Saures!", "Danke Jackie")
pour jouer des enfants fêtant Halloween

**VENDREDI 11 SEPTEMBRE**
**une partie de la journée entre 08H00 et 19H00**
**ESNEUX (à proximité de Liège)**
**140 €**

Si vous êtes disponibles et intéressés, ne tardez pas à nous envoyer un mail à l'adresse** blanche.castpro@gmail.com avec l'objet "HALLOWEEN" et une VIDÉO DE PRÉSENTATION EN ALLEMAND**.

Si nous n'avons jamais travaillé ensemble, merci d'envoyer également : NOM, PRÉNOM, DATE DE NAISSANCE, NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE, VILLE DE RÉSIDENCE et 2-3 PHOTOS.

N'hésitez pas à partager l'annonce à toutes vos connaissances !

Maxime Burton

Blanche Amphiarus-Deprée

URGENT CASTING RÔLE Comédiens Hommes d'origine Maghrébine avec accent Marseillais entre 20 et 30 ans( âge apparent )pour 1 date le 07 Septembre sur CASSIS
( pas de candidature en MP et merci de VRAIMENT lire attentivement l’annonce jusqu’au bout avant de postuler 🙏🏻 )!

Bonjour à tous,
Dans le cadre d’une mini série pour une plateforme, je suis à la recherche d’un comédien d'origine Maghrébine, basé dans le Sud, idéalement avec l'accent marseillais( ou du Sud ).
Entre 20 et 30 ans( âge apparent ), pour incarner un barman, sexy et sûr de lui, d'un bar de plage branché censé être à St Tropez en 2005.
Physique agréable et musclé avec si possible des notions de barman.

1 date de tournage à CASSIS le LUNDI 07 SEPTEMBRE,
tarif syndical TV rôle à minima, à négocier avec la production( 304,99 euros bruts ).
Casting sur selftape cette semaine.

Je ne cherche QUE ce profil et uniquement des comédiens, merci donc de ne pas postuler si vous ne correspondez pas à cette annonce.

Si vous êtes intéressés, que vous correspondez aux critères et êtes disponibles sur la période de tournage merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : uas.casting@gmail.com
IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le profil du rôle pour lequel vous postulez + Prénom + NOM + Âge + Taille.
Exemple : « BARMAN ST TROP, Mehdi ALLAOUI 25 ans 1m84 »,

Les candidatures qui ne rempliront pas ces critères ne seront pas étudiées.
Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre IMPÉRATIVEMENT :
-Vos indisponibilités connues( ou disponibilités )pour le tournage entre le 04 et le 11 SEPTEMBRE
- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)
- Numéro de téléphone
-Date et lieu de naissance
- Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )
-Vos mensurations
- Plusieurs photos de vous récentes( dont à minima 1 portrait, 1 photo en pied et 1 selfie du jour pour voir votre coupe actuelle )
-Merci de préciser si vous acceptez une couleur, coupe de cheveux/barbe ou pas si nécessaire
-Un CV et une bande démo si vous en avez une
-Le nom de votre agent si vous en avez un
-Précisez si vous acceptez éventuellement la figuration, si vous n’êtes pas retenus, pour mon fichier
-Votre expérience en barman si vous en avez une
Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous recontacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond pour un éventuel casting.

Merci par avance à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée !! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais
uas.casting@gmail.com
@à la une

CASTING CALL

As the Sun Sets, Student Short Film 

A coming-of-age drama following a Miami family of 3: a 17-year-old Soleil, her mother Sandra, and her father Cruz. After Soleil is invited to a prestigious dance audition for her dream school, they embark on a journey along the East coast where they are forced to confront their complicated reality as family. 

Filming Location: Tallahassee, FL

All Roles: Unpaid. Travel & accommodation expenses covered. All Meals Provided 

Union/Non-Union, Professional and Non-Professional Actors.

Now Casting:

Supporting
* Sandra — Female, 40–59, Hispanic/Latina, Puerto-Rican. Sandra is a perfectionist dedicated to her roles as mother, wife, and chef. She upholds the same high standards in others as she does in herself. *Must be able to speak fluent Spanish (colloquial Puerto Rican).*
* Cruz — Male, 40–59, Hispanic/Latino, Cuban-American. Cruz is a frustrated workaholic. He's afraid of his age and a victim of his past. He pushes his family away in an attempt to fulfill his dreams, while simultaneously living vicariously through his daughter's. *Must be able to speak intermediate Spanish (ideally colloquial Cuban and Miami dialect) and be comfortable driving while performing.*

(If available) Send Headshot, Resume & Demo Reel to: 

ava22c@fsu.edu

Submission Deadline: August 30th

Shoot Dates: 4 Days • Sept 10th - 13th

*I’m a part Puerto-Rican, part Cuban filmmaker born and raised in Miami, Florida. This story is very near and dear to me and my upbringing plays a huge part. That being said, the cultural authenticity of the film is of utmost importance to me, that’s why I’m looking for real Puerto Ricans and Cubans who really connect with this story to be a part of this project. There’s no previous acting experience required, but we are just as open to having working actors too. Thank you!

Jodi Purdy Casting Director sharing for Paul D Head!

Greetings! My name is Paul Head, and I’m a Los Angeles-based non-scripted Casting Director. You can view my credits and credentials at www.pauldhead.com. I’m currently casting a premium documentary series for a major cable network exploring an often-unspoken experience.

We’re looking nationwide for people whose spouse or long-term life partner suddenly and unexpectedly left, vanished, or ghosted them without explanation—including people who are still legally married but don’t know where their husband or wife is. 

We’re specifically seeking people who are not currently in communication with their partner, don’t know where they are, don’t understand why they left, and have been unable to find them on their own.

The series offers expert help in finding answers, gaining clarity, and hopefully getting the closure you’ve been looking for.

This is a paid documentary series featuring real people and real, ongoing situations.

If this sounds like you or someone you know, we’d like to hear from you. We’re casting nationwide now! To apply and for more information: casting@bodegapictures.com

DDO vs Coast to Coast
Hello everyone,

I hope your days are going lovely and if you’re starting school soon that the summer is winding down smoothly. It’s insanity over here haha.

I had a question for anyone that’s worked with DDO or Cosst to Coast. My daughter’s are currently signed with Coast to Coast in their commercial division. They haven’t been sent much but honestly a lot of their resume and experience has been on stage. They are both in musical theater conservatory, my oldest for the past three years, and are on competitive mt jazz, tap and hiphop teams. They also both are in private vocal lessons. So much is focused on performing on stage that I’m wondering if maybe there isn’t a better fit at DDO for them?

What’s been your experience? 

These are my girls 🥹 thanks for any and all insight!

topComments.text: We are with Coast to Coast and my daughter receives high level film/tv auditions.

We just signed with Coast to Coast! My son is 14 and a musical theater kid. We switched agents because MT dries up for teen boys and wanted an LA focus for film/tv. 🤞🏻My extensive research, however, would say that if your girls want that field, you are best with NYC agency with deep ties to casting agents Telsey and Tara Rubin. My son was with Carson Adler and got lots of great MT opportunities including getting cast on a national tour. Good luck!

What’s been your experience? 

These are my girls 🥹 thanks for any and all insight!

**CASTING CALL - SHORT STUDENT FILM - NON-UNION**

**Shoot Date: **Sunday Aug 23rd**, **2026

**Location: **East Vancouver, BC

**Compensation:** Non-paid (volunteer)

We're casting two middle-aged men and two middle-aged woman to be in our short film. 

**Synopsis: **They're bored, so they found something to do. Maya and Daniel have something to hide, and so do Sophie and Alex. Between secret meetings and charged innuendos, one secret binds them all together. 

## Roles:
1. **Maya (Female, 35-50): **Maya is the witty and introverted English teacher who is exceptionally good at her newfound talent, miming. 
2. **Sophie (Female, 35-50): **Sophie is the cool, calm and collected art teacher** **whose sharp as a whip. She's oftentimes bored, and is looking for something fun to do to spice up her life. (May have to smoke a fake cigarette)
3. **Daniel (Male, 35-50): **Daniel is the macho man. Think cool gym teacher with an ego. He enjoys teasing others and is a bit of a goof ball. 
4. **Alex (Male, 35-50): **Alex is an anxious chemistry teacher who DREADS keeping secrets. He is, however, determined to impress Maya with his skills. 

**Please submit your CV and reel to auditions@kyliehatton.com using subject line: FATAL ATTRACTION - (Role) - (Your name).**

**Communication done through email ONLY**

**Additional Info:**
* Information about rehearsal will be communicated to you
* Sophies role may have to smoke a fake cigarette

Looking forward to potentially working with you :)

🎭 𝐀𝐔𝐃𝐈𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍 𝐒𝐋𝐎𝐓𝐒 𝐍𝐎𝐖 𝐎𝐏𝐄𝐍 🎭 

Turn “𝐈’𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐜𝐭” 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 “𝐈’𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐫.” If you’re serious about making an impact in modern TV, Film, and Theatre, standard classes aren't enough.

𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲, 𝐢𝐧 𝐒𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐧, 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫, provides a higher standard of training for performers aged 17+ who are ready to strip away bad habits and master real, repeatable screen and stage techniques. 

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲?

• 𝐒𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐀𝐜𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐝: Train with a recognised, accredited drama school that elevates your industry standing. 

• 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝-𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲: Proud two-time consecutive winner of ‘Best Drama School of the Year’. 

• 𝐃𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐲 𝐌𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩: Work directly under Christian Le Feuvre—a LAMDA-qualified actor and award-winning filmmaker. 

• 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 & 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐧: Tailored modules designed to give you the exact technical control required in real audition rooms. 

𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐖𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫: 

• 🎬 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐭 𝐀𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐲𝐬𝐢𝐬 & 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Uncover deep subtext and build authentic, multi-layered characters. 

• 🎥 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐂𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐚: Master the subtle, intimate precision required for screen performance. 

• 🎭 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐢𝐪𝐮𝐞: Build the technical control and unshakeable confidence required to command any audition room. 

𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧:

• 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM 

• 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: Swinton, Manchester 

• 𝐓𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐭 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞: Actors aged 17 and upward

𝐓𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐩: Stop wishing for opportunities and start equipping yourself to capture them. Places are kept limited to ensure every actor receives dedicated direction. 

Watch student testimonials and claim your audition slot today at 𝐰𝐰𝐰.𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲.𝐜𝐨.𝐮𝐤

“𝑫𝑶𝑵’𝑻 𝑩𝑬 𝑨𝑵 𝑨𝑪𝑻𝑶𝑹 𝑩𝑬𝑪𝑨𝑼𝑺𝑬 𝒀𝑶𝑼 𝑾𝑨𝑵𝑻 𝑻𝑶; 𝑩𝑬 𝑨𝑵 𝑨𝑪𝑻𝑶𝑹 𝑩𝑬𝑪𝑨𝑼𝑺𝑬 𝒀𝑶𝑼 𝑯𝑨𝑽𝑬 𝑻𝑶!”

🎭 𝐀𝐔𝐃𝐈𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍 𝐒𝐋𝐎𝐓𝐒 𝐍𝐎𝐖 𝐎𝐏𝐄𝐍 🎭 

Turn “𝐈’𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐜𝐭” 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 “𝐈’𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐫.” If you’re serious about making an impact in modern TV, Film, and Theatre, standard classes aren't enough.

𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲, 𝐢𝐧 𝐒𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐧, 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫, provides a higher standard of training for performers aged 17+ who are ready to strip away bad habits and master real, repeatable screen and stage techniques. 

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲?

• 𝐒𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐀𝐜𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐝: Train with a recognised, accredited drama school that elevates your industry standing. 

• 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝-𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲: Proud two-time consecutive winner of ‘Best Drama School of the Year’. 

• 𝐃𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐲 𝐌𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩: Work directly under Christian Le Feuvre—a LAMDA-qualified actor and award-winning filmmaker. 

• 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 & 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐧: Tailored modules designed to give you the exact technical control required in real audition rooms. 

𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐖𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫: 

• 🎬 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐭 𝐀𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐲𝐬𝐢𝐬 & 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Uncover deep subtext and build authentic, multi-layered characters. 

• 🎥 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐂𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐚: Master the subtle, intimate precision required for screen performance. 

• 🎭 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐢𝐪𝐮𝐞: Build the technical control and unshakeable confidence required to command any audition room. 

𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧:

• 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM

items.text:
🎙️ POSZUKIWANI AKTORZY GŁOSOWI DO FILMU ANIMOWANEGO 🎬

[ Warszawa / graffiti / hip-hop / animacja 3D ]

👉 PROJEKT PASJONACKI (NON-PROFIT) 👈

Tworzę 15-minutowy niezależny film animowany osadzony w undergroundowym świecie warszawskiego graffiti. To historia o grupie grafficiarzy, zaufaniu i uprzedzeniach.

🔥 CO WYRÓŻNIA TEN PROJEKT?

To nie jest kolejna fikcyjna opowieść zza biurka. Film powstaje w ścisłej współpracy ze środowiskiem:

✓ W projekcie biorą udział znani polscy grafficiarze, którzy oficjalnie przekazali swoje prawdziwe prace do odwzorowania w świecie 3D.

✓ Warstwę muzyczną stworzą producenci i DJ-e mocno związani ze sceną hip-hopową.

✓ Mamy już gotowy scenariusz, storyboardy, blockouty 3D i animatic (którego fragment widzisz w tym poście!).

👇 ZOBACZ NASZ ANIMATIK (2:30 min) WGRANY BEZPOŚREDNIO DO POSTA! 👇

👤 KOGO SZUKAMY? (4 ROLE GŁOSOWE)

Nie musisz być profesjonalistą. Szukamy ludzi z charakterem i naturalnością.

1️⃣ SCAR (mężczyzna, 24 lata) – charyzmatyczny, energiczny, wyluzowany, kocha ryzyko i adrenalinę.

2️⃣ MROZ (mężczyzna, 25 lat) – spokojny, ostrożny, pewny siebie.

🌟 WAŻNE: Do tej roli szukamy osoby z naturalnym ukraińskim lub białoruskim akcentem!

3️⃣ HUSAR (mężczyzna,  21 lat) – twardy, emocjonalny, bezpośredni. Trenuje sporty walki i maluje graffiti.

4️⃣ GAJA (kobieta, 23 lata) – opanowana, zdystansowana tatuatorka. Ma sarkastyczne poczucie humoru.

🎥 ZAKRES WSPÓŁPRACY (Głos + Referencje wideo)

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

1. Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

2. Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

🎙️ krótkie nagranie głosowe z wybranymi kwestiami castingowymi

(próbkę tekstu z materiałem do nagrania znajdziesz w dokumencie w pierwszym komentarzu pod postem)

📁 portfolio / wcześniejsze nagrania — jeśli je posiadasz

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

👇 LINK DO DOKUMENTU Z TEKSTAMI I SZCZEGÓŁAMI ZNAJDZIESZ W PIERWSZYM KOMENTARZU! 👇

🎙️ POSZUKIWANI AKTORZY GŁOSOWI DO FILMU ANIMOWANEGO 🎬

[ Warszawa / graffiti / hip-hop / animacja 3D ]

👉 PROJEKT PASJONACKI (NON-PROFIT) 👈

Tworzę 15-minutowy niezależny film animowany osadzony w undergroundowym świecie warszawskiego graffiti. To historia o grupie grafficiarzy, zaufaniu i uprzedzeniach.

🔥 CO WYRÓŻNIA TEN PROJEKT?

To nie jest kolejna fikcyjna opowieść zza biurka. Film powstaje w ścisłej współpracy ze środowiskiem:

✓ W projekcie biorą udział znani polscy grafficiarze, którzy oficjalnie przekazali swoje prawdziwe prace do odwzorowania w świecie 3D.

✓ Warstwę muzyczną stworzą producenci i DJ-e mocno związani ze sceną hip-hopową.

✓ Mamy już gotowy scenariusz, storyboardy, blockouty 3D i animatic (którego fragment widzisz w tym poście!).

👇 ZOBACZ NASZ ANIMATIK (2:30 min) WGRANY BEZPOŚREDNIO DO POSTA! 👇

👤 KOGO SZUKAMY? (4 ROLE GŁOSOWE)

Nie musisz być profesjonalistą. Szukamy ludzi z charakterem i naturalnością.

1️⃣ SCAR (mężczyzna, 24 lata) – charyzmatyczny, energiczny, wyluzowany, kocha ryzyko i adrenalinę.

2️⃣ MROZ (mężczyzna, 25 lat) – spokojny, ostrożny, pewny siebie.

🌟 WAŻNE: Do tej roli szukamy osoby z naturalnym ukraińskim lub białoruskim akcentem!

3️⃣ HUSAR (mężczyzna,  21 lat) – twardy, emocjonalny, bezpośredni. Trenuje sporty walki i maluje graffiti.

4️⃣ GAJA (kobieta, 23 lata) – opanowana, zdystansowana tatuatorka. Ma sarkastyczne poczucie humoru.

🎥 ZAKRES WSPÓŁPRACY (Głos + Referencje wideo)

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

1. Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

2. Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

🎙️ krótkie nagranie głosowe z wybranymi kwestiami castingowymi

(próbkę tekstu z materiałem do nagrania znajdziesz w dokumencie w pierwszym komentarzu pod postem)

📁 portfolio / wcześniejsze nagrania — jeśli je posiadasz

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

👇 LINK DO DOKUMENTU Z TEKSTAMI I SZCZEGÓŁAMI ZNAJDZIESZ W PIERWSZYM KOMENTARZU! 👇

🎵 Szukamy prowadzących zajęcia muzyczne dla dzieci 🎵

📍 Warszawa · Łódź · Gdańsk · Wrocław · Poznań 

Akademia Bachmana prowadzi zajęcia muzyczne w żłobkach i przedszkolach: prowadzący plus muzyk grający na żywo, 30 minut, gotowy scenariusz. Reszta to Wasza inwencja. Na sezon 2026/2027 szukamy osób do trzech typów zajęć:

🎼 audycje muzyczne — opowieść o muzyce i kontakt z dziećmi, prezentacja instrumentu 
🎭 zajęcia musicalowe — śpiew, ruch, praca nad małą formą sceniczną
🗣️ English Music — zajęcia prowadzone w całości po angielsku

Kogo szukamy?
✔️ wykształcenia muzycznego, wokalnego, aktorskiego, tanecznego lub pedagogicznego
✔️ swobody w pracy z maluchami — i odwagi, żeby zaczarować salę
✔️ prawa jazdy kat. B oraz zaświadczenia o niekaralności
➕ atutem są: metoda E. E. Gordona, doświadczenie musicalowe lub teatralne, a przy English Music angielski na poziomie min. B2

Co oferujemy?
🔹 pracę od poniedziałku do piątku w godzinach porannych — bez wieczorów i weekendów
🔹 firmowe auto i zwrot kosztów dojazdu
🔹 gotowy grafik ustalony na cały sezon
🔹 bezpłatne wejścia na wydarzenia, które organizujemy
🔹 zespół prowadzących i mastermindy z muzykami, aktorami, pedagogiem

Średnio 40 grup w miesiącu, spotkania po 30 minut. Umowa o dzieło lub B2B — do uzgodnienia.

Pełne ogłoszenia — szczegóły, wymagania i warunki:
🎼 audycje muzyczne — https://przesluchania.com/produkt/oferta-pracy-dla-osoby-prowadzacej-audycje-muzyczne-akademia-bachmana/
🎭 zajęcia musicalowe — https://przesluchania.com/produkt/oferta-pracy-dla-osoby-prowadzacej-zajecia-musicalowe-akademia-bachmana/
🗣️ English Music — https://przesluchania.com/produkt/oferta-pracy-dla-osoby-prowadzacej-english-music-akademia-bachmana/

📩 Zgłoszenia przez formularz: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSciMOJgaQ3qMqY9emnUS76UNwnuL5aG3EqoZ5-YodpYKhb_uA/viewform
✉️ CV i nagranie (portfolio): kadry.akademiabachmana@gmail.com

W formularzu zaznaczasz miasto i typ zajęć — można wybrać kilka.

Piszcie śmiało w komentarzach albo na priv — chętnie odpowiem na pytania. Udostępnienie mile widziane 🙏

👉**DOUBLURES COMÉDIENS PRINCIPAUX**👈** **

Bonjour à toutes et tous,

Nous sommes à la recherche de deux DOUBLURES CONDUITE sur la série de téléfilms belgo-allemande ***EIFELTOD*** !
En 2 x 90 min, nous serons plongés dans deux enquêtes criminelles révélant progressivement des tragédies familiales.

Nous recherchons :

**FEMME entre 30 et 60 ans**

Mark Your Calendar!!/NOW CASTING both AEA and non-union talent!!
SG Casting is casting The Lone Tree Arts Center’s production of Amadeus in Lone Tree, Colorado!

Both local and non-local talent are encouraged to submit an audition!

AEA audition sign ups will open on Monday, August 17th.

Non-AEA audition sign ups will open on Wednesday, August 26th.

If you are local, please sign up for an in-person audition if possible.  

If you are not local, please plan to submit a video audition. 

The Lone Tree Arts Center’s Executive Director is Leigh Chandler.

LORT D Contract

Weekly Rate:

$950.00 minimum for Principals and Understudies/Swings

Director: Geoffrey Kent

Executive Director: Leigh Chandler

Casting Director: Sylvia Gregory, CSA

All above creative team members will be present at auditions and viewing audition videos.

In Person Initial Auditions: Monday September 14th and Tuesday September 15th.

In Person Callbacks: Monday October 5th; will add Tuesday October 6th if needed.

Video general auditions are due by Friday September 11th..

Video callbacks are due by Friday, October 2nd.

First Rehearsal - 3/16/27

Tech Starts - 3/31/27

Invited Rehearsals - 4/7/27

Opening - 4/8/27

Closing - 4/18/27

General Audition Requirements:

Please prepare one monologue or two contrasting monologues not to exceed 3 minutes total.

For in-person and video auditions:

In person auditions are by appointment only. Sign up, upload headshots and resumes, and/or submit your videos all at this link: 

https://www.lonetreeartscenter.org/amadeusauditions

Headshot and Resume are REQUIRED to be uploaded into Production Tools.

Do not contact members of the production teams. If you have any questions, contact Saundra Bergman at Saundra.Bergman@cityoflonetree.com.

The Lone Tree Arts Center is committed to diversity and maintains a policy of equal employment opportunity designed to promote a positive model of inclusion. As such, we encourage performers of all ethnicities, gender identities, body types and sizes, and ages, as well as performers with disabilities, to audition for appropriate roles.

The Lone Tree Arts Center creates a safe and equitable workplace through policies defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, the Actors’ Equity Association, and the City of Lone Tree. These policies provide a comprehensive framework for health and safety of all actors, stage managers, creative staff, and designers employed by The Lone Tree Arts Center.

Information and Character Breakdown

CASTING NOTE:

Antonio Salieri and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart will be cast with male-presenting performers. Constanze Weber will be cast with a female-identifying performer, as the character is pregnant at one point in the play. 

All other roles are open to performers of any gender. Performers of all genders and gender expressions are encouraged to audition. 

Character genders, pronouns, relationships, and historical identities will remain as written in the script; performers will not be asked to portray a gender different from their own.

Roles:

ANTONIO SALIERI, male-presenting, 50 to 65

Court Composer to the Emperor. Brilliant, ambitious, and deeply conflicted, he serves as narrator while recounting his lifelong rivalry with Mozart. Exceptional command of language and emotional range required.

WOLFGANG AMADEUS MOZART, male-presenting, 25 to 35

A musical genius with boundless wit, irreverence, and youthful energy. Mercurial, funny, and deeply vulnerable beneath his exuberance.

CONSTANZE WEBER MOZART, female-presenting, 20 to 35 

Mozart’s devoted wife. Intelligent, resilient, and fiercely practical as she struggles to support her husband and family. Role will also include Ensemble work.

EMPEROR JOSEPH II, 35 to 55 

Emperor of Austria. Affable, curious, and genuinely devoted to music, though often unaware of his own limitations. Strong comic instincts. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON VAN SWIETEN, 50 to 70 

Influential patron of the arts. Intellectual, dignified, and quietly authoritative. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT VON STRACK, 35 to 60 

Court official. Polished, ambitious, and committed to preserving decorum and tradition. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT ORSINI-ROSENBERG, 40 to 65 

Imperial Director of Opera. Conservative, politically savvy, and skeptical of artistic risk. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON WALSEGG, 40 to 65 

Wealthy aristocrat with a mysterious presence. Reserved and imposing. Role will also include Ensemble work.

Two VENTICELLI, 30 to 50 

The “Little Winds.” Nimble storytellers who provide gossip, exposition, and comic energy. Excellent timing and verbal dexterity required.

KATHERINA CAVALIERI, 20 to 40 

Celebrated soprano and former student of Salieri. Confident, poised, and accustomed to admiration. Classical singing ability welcome but not required. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

TERESA SALIERI, 40 to 60 

Salieri’s wife. Quiet, observant presence. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

ENSEMBLE

18+ To portray courtiers, servants, musicians, clergy, and opera performers. Strong ensemble skills and comfort with multiple roles. Singing and movement abilities a plus.

Title: Nuclear Supper

Genre: Music Video/Short film

Logline: A young woman travels through a post-apocalyptic land and encounters a supernatural group of revelers

Actress wanted to star in our second music video. This is for our song "Nuclear Supper". Looking for a young woman, late teens to 20's. Not set on a particular look beyond the wardrobe. You don't have to be a beauty queen...just appear resilient and determined in a post-apocalyptic world. Think "Mad Max"/Furiosa.
* no lines to learn
* non-paid/non-union
* meals provided
* Filming over 2-4 days, likely starting the evening of Tue October 13. Schedule still forming
* Filmed in Lafayette, Broomfield, Longmont
* Primarily outside. One interior scene

We have lined up a really awesome film crew. We will be looking for extras in a separate post, so if you like the look of the project and want a smaller commitment, let me know!

Contact me via Facebook or email ninewidesky@gmail.com. We're new at this, so ask any and all questions!

I have put together a story board on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWkgwZHhykk

Band site:

https://www.ninewidesky.com/

🎬 CASTING CALL – OFFIZIELLES MUSIKVIDEO „TITTEN & BIER“ 🍺☀️

Für das offizielle Musikvideo zur neuen Party-Single „Titten & Bier“ von Ricky Leroy suchen wir gut gelaunte Menschen, die Lust auf einen sommerlichen Drehtag voller Party-Atmosphäre haben.

Das Projekt:
Es handelt sich umein unabhängiges Low-Budget-Musikvideoprojekt. 

Daher können wir leider keinebranchenübliche Gage zahlen. Als Dank für deine Zeit erhältst du eine Aufwandsentschädigung von 75 €, kostenlose Getränke sowie dein persönliches Footage für Showreel oder Social Media.

Wen wir suchen:
Wir suchen Personenab 18 Jahren für eine ausgelassene Poolparty-Szene.

GROUNDHOG DAY THE MUSICAL AUDITIONS! 

SEEKING: Local, Non-Equity performers for various roles and ensemble in the upcoming 2027 production of GROUNDHOG DAY THE MUSICAL. See breakdown for details. All performers should be 16+. Performers of all ethnic and racial backgrounds are encouraged to attend. 

LOCATION: Delray Beach Playhouse (950 NW 9th Street Delray Beach, FL 33444) 

DATE / TIME OF AUDITION: 
- Tuesday, September 1st between 6pm and 10pm
- Wednesday, September 2nd between 6pm and 10pm

PREPARATION: 
- Prepare one brief comedic monologue (~1 minute)
- Prepare 16 bars of a musical theatre song in the style of the show. Tracks are preferred and a Bluetooth speaker will be provided. An accompanist will also be available.
- Please bring 1 copy of your picture/resume (if available), glued or stapled together.
- You may be asked to read from the script
- You may be asked to dance. Bring appropriate clothing and shoes you can move in.

*WE ARE ALSO ACCEPTING VIDEO SUBMISSIONS by August 31st at 9:00PM. 
-Slate: Your name and confirm that you live local to Delray  
- 16 bars of a musical theatre song in the style of the show.  
- A brief comic monologue (~1 minute)
- If you have a dance reel, please include that in a separate video 

AUDITION SIGN-UPS AND MORE INFO HERE!: https://delraybeachplayhouse.com/delray-auditions/

Please do not call the Delray Beach Playhouse box office with questions regarding these auditions. Please email questions to dbpauditions@gmail.com

📅 Freelance / weekend projects throughout the year

items.text:
Hi, ich bin **Berhane Berhane**, Comedian, Schauspieler, Entertainer und Moderator aus München. 

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **neuen Jobs, Castings und spannenden Projekten im Film-, TV-, Werbe- und Entertainmentbereich**.

 **Schauspiel – Deutsch & Englisch**
Meine **Schauspielausbildung habe ich in den USA absolviert** und selbst einige Zeit in **Los Angeles** gelebt. Dadurch kann ich Rollen sowohl **auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch** spielen und bin auch für internationale bzw. englischsprachige Produktionen einsetzbar.

 **Comedy, Moderation & Entertainment**
Als Comedian bringe ich langjährige Bühnenerfahrung, Timing, Improvisation und Spontaneität mit. Zusätzlich werde ich regelmäßig als **Moderator und DJ** für Veranstaltungen gebucht.

 **Action, Kampfsport & Stunts**
Ich habe **Thaiboxen und Kung-Fu** trainiert und kann bei entsprechenden Produktionen auch körperliche Rollen und Stunts selbst übernehmen.

 **Fitness, Tanz & Bewegung**
Durch meine **Trainer-C-Lizenz im Fitness- und Tanzbereich** kann ich ebenfalls für Produktionen eingesetzt werden, bei denen Fitness, Tanz, Bewegung oder Choreografie gefragt sind.

 **Snowboard**
Seit **über 25 Jahren arbeite ich als Snowboardlehrer** und bringe entsprechend viel Erfahrung auf dem Board mit. Damit bin ich auch für Film-, TV-, Werbe- und Actionproduktionen im Wintersportbereich interessant.

**Mein Profil:**
 Schauspiel Deutsch & Englisch
 Comedy & Improvisation
 Moderation & Entertainment
 DJ
 Thaiboxen & Kung-Fu
 Action & Stunts
 Fitness & Tanz
 Über 25 Jahre Erfahrung als Snowboardlehrer

 **Casting-Agenturen, Produktionsfirmen, Regisseure & Veranstalter:**
Wenn ihr für euer nächstes Projekt einen vielseitigen Darsteller und Entertainer sucht, freue ich mich über eure Nachricht. **Ich bin offen für Castings, Drehs, Werbung, TV, Film und neue spannende Projekte.**

Gerne teilen & weiterempfehlen. 

**Berhane Berhane**

CASTING CALL | FOURCE

ISO: RAPPERS, DANCERS & SINGERS
Fource is looking for two new members to join our global girl group.

AUDITIONS
Applicants must be 18+.
Submit your audition here:
https://forms.gle/TqzVJZ2rsbizgWQ77

ABOUT FOURCE
Fource is an independent global girl group based in the United States that follows the K-Pop system. We create and perform original music and choreography.
Our concept is centered around the five elements: Water, Earth, Fire, Air, and Spirit.
We are currently casting for the Air and Fire elements.

AIR ELEMENT
Personality: Bubbly, energetic, and “sunshine”
Preferred Vocal Range: Mid Alto to High Soprano
Preferred Role: Main Rapper / Main Dancer
Inspirations: Rei Ami, Tate McRae, Sabrina Carpenter, Lisa, Rosé, Yuki, Yeji, Rei
We are looking for someone with strong stage presence, versatility, charisma, and an energetic performance style.

FIRE ELEMENT
Personality: Confident, grounded, and charismatic
Preferred Vocal Range: Alto to Low Soprano
Preferred Role: Main Dancer
Inspirations: Manon of KATSEYE, JENNIE, Savanna of Girlset, Yeji, Alexa, Bailey Sok
We are looking for someone with strong dance ability, confidence, natural charisma, and commanding stage presence.

For questions, comment below or contact FourceBand@gmail.com.

We’re looking for dedicated performers who are ready to grow, create, and perform with Fource.

Currently unpaid but in process of payment options.

# 🎬 CASTING CALL — PSYCHOLOGICAL THRILLER / DRAMA SHORT FILM - PAID

We are currently casting actors for an upcoming **Psychological Thriller / Drama short film** shooting later this year.

🎥 **Narrative Short Film**
📅 **Shoot Dates:** Around October–November 2026
⏱️ **Production:** 6–7 Shooting Days
📍 **Location:** Orlando,FL

**WIFE — LEAD**
👤 Female, early 30s
💰 **$300/day**

The central character of the story. We are looking for a strong dramatic performer capable of carrying emotionally intense material while delivering a **grounded, natural, and believable performance**.

Must be comfortable portraying fear, suspense, vulnerability, emotional distress, and psychologically intense situations.

**FATHER — SUPPORTING LEAD**
👤 Male, late 30s
💰 **$250/day**

Playing a husband.

Seeking a strong dramatic actor capable of portraying **emotional tension w**hile maintaining a grounded and believable performance.

**CHILD — SUPPORTING**
👦 Child actor, approximately 7–9 years old
💰 **$100/day**
📅 **Required for only 2 shooting days**

A supporting role with limited dialogue but an important emotional presence within the story and family dynamic.

Seeking a child with a **natural and believable acting style** who is comfortable performing in a paranormal/suspenseful environment.

Previous acting experience is preferred but **not required**.

A parent/guardian will be required to participate throughout the casting and production process.

📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:

📸 **Headshot**
📄 **Acting Resume**
🎞️ **Demo Reel / Acting Reel**
📍 **Current Location**
🎭 **Role You Are Applying **

Please submit to our email.

**Email:** [Admin@BigQStudios.com](mailto:Admin@BigQStudios.com)

Selected actors will receive additional character information and **audition/self-tape instructions**.

**Serious submissions only.**

We are looking for talented performers who can bring **emotionally grounded, believable performances** to a dark, unsettling, and psychological story.

🎬 **If you or someone you know is a strong fit, send them this casting call.**
